mapper.sql: FROM mst.ptnr p LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl k ON k.cd_grp_id = 'PARTNER_KIND' AND k.dtl_cd = p.ptnr_se_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl i ON i.cd_grp_id = 'INDUSTRY' AND i.dtl_cd = p.indty_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl b ON b.cd_grp_id = 'BANK' AND b.dtl_cd = p.bank_cd
p.ptnr_id, p.ptnr_no, p.ptnr_se_cd, p.ptnr_nm, p.biz_reg_no, p.use_yn, p.ceo_nm, p.indty_cd, p.chrg_nm, p.chrg_tel_no, k.cd_nm AS kind_name, i.cd_nm AS industry_name

where.if: AND (p.ptnr_nm ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR REPLACE(p.biz_reg_no, '-', '') LIKE '%' || REPLACE(#{q}, '-', '') || '%')

mapper.sql: SELECT j.prj_id FROM prj.prj j WHERE j.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN', 'RUN', 'HOLD') AND ( (p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST', 'BOTH') AND j.cust_ptnr_id = p.ptnr_id) OR (p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND', 'BOTH') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id = a.dev_id WHERE a.prj_id = j.prj_id AND d.vndr_ptnr_id = p.ptnr_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} )) )
mapper.select:
SELECT v.* FROM ( SELECT , CASE WHEN p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST', 'BOTH') THEN p.txinv_email_addr END AS txinv_email_addr, CASE WHEN p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND', 'BOTH') AND p.acnt_no IS NOT NULL THEN b.cd_nm || ' …' || RIGHT(p.acnt_no, 4) END AS payment_account_summary, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () scope) AS ongoing_project_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj j ON j.prj_id = a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id = a.dev_id WHERE j.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN', 'RUN', 'HOLD') AND a.asgn_stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND ( (p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST', 'BOTH') AND j.cust_ptnr_id = p.ptnr_id) OR (p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND', 'BOTH') AND d.vndr_ptnr_id = p.ptnr_id) ) ) AS assigned_developer_count
) v ORDER BY v.${order} ${direction}, v.ptnr_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{start}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mst.ptnr ( ptnr_id, ptnr_no, ptnr_se_cd, ptnr_nm, biz_reg_no, ceo_nm, indty_cd, chrg_nm, chrg_tel_no, txinv_email_addr, bank_cd, acnt_no, dpstr_nm, use_yn, created_by ) VALUES ( #{row.id}, #{row.no}, #{row.ptnrSeCd}, #{row.ptnrNm}, #{row.bizRegNo}, #{row.ceoNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.indtyCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.chrgNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.chrgTelNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.txinvEmailAddr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.bankCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.acntNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.dpstrNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_ptnr_biz_reg_no DO NOTHING
mapper.update:
UPDATE mst.ptnr
ptnr_se_cd = #{changes.ptnr_se_cd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
ptnr_nm = #{changes.ptnr_nm,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
ceo_nm = #{changes.ceo_nm,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
indty_cd = #{changes.indty_cd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
chrg_nm = #{changes.chrg_nm,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
chrg_tel_no = #{changes.chrg_tel_no,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
txinv_email_addr = #{changes.txinv_email_addr,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
bank_cd = #{changes.bank_cd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
acnt_no = #{changes.acnt_no,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
dpstr_nm = #{changes.dpstr_nm,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
updated_by = #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT}
WHERE ptnr_id = #{id}
